description:
Fire2Kodi is an Android app to send various video links from webbrowser to Video Addons on Kodi Device – e.g. Youtube, Rumble, Odysee, Bitchute – via clipboard or send-to menu. Kore sends links to Kodi devices but cannot translate them for the specific video Addons. This app translates links from webbrowser for the following video Addons:
• Youtube
• Rumble
• Bitchute
• Amazon Prime
• Twitch
• Kick
• Odysee
• Vimeo
• Dailymotion
• Joyn (Germany, Austria, Switzerland)
